moderate.title: Rain Alert
moderate.body: Moderate rain expected in your area. Carry an umbrella and allow extra travel time.

severe.title: Severe Rain Warning
severe.body: Heavy rainfall expected. Avoid low-lying areas and unnecessary travel.

moderate.title: Storm Alert
moderate.body: A storm system is approaching your area. Secure loose outdoor items.

severe.title: Severe Storm Warning
severe.body: Dangerous storm conditions expected. Stay indoors and away from windows.

moderate.title: Heat Alert
moderate.body: Temperatures are rising above normal. Stay hydrated and limit midday sun exposure.

severe.title: Severe Heatwave Warning
severe.body: Extreme heat expected. Avoid outdoor activity 11am–4pm and check on elderly neighbors.

moderate.title: Marine Alert
moderate.body: Choppy sea conditions expected. Small boats should exercise caution.

severe.title: Severe Marine Warning
severe.body: Dangerous sea conditions. Fishing and boating activity strongly discouraged.

foreignerComparison.title: How does this compare to your home climate?

uk.name: United Kingdom
uk.comparisonNote: Chennai's summer heat is far more intense than the UK's warmest days

us.name: United States
us.comparisonNote: Chennai's cyclone season is comparable to the US Gulf Coast hurricane season

ca.name: Canada
ca.comparisonNote: Chennai never sees snow or freezing temperatures, unlike most of Canada's winter

jp.name: Japan
jp.comparisonNote: Japan's typhoon season closely parallels Chennai's Northeast monsoon and cyclone risk

au.name: Australia
au.comparisonNote: Australia's seasons are reversed — their summer matches Chennai's cooler months
